meta.drift_note: Menu-bar D / P segments: design.md/implement.md describe the original design at the time of completion; the current implementation has drifted. design.md/implement.md describe the segments as additive to a fixed-width status item. The shipped implementation computes the item width from the settings flags every time they change (`AppDelegate.statusBarLength`), so toggling segments in Settings resizes the menu-bar item live. Pointer: docs/ARCHITECTURE.md.
